newsitem.title: UK: Eurotherm buys U.S. firm for $12.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Eurotherm buys U.S. firm for $12.5 mln.

text.p: Britain's Eurotherm Plc said on Thursday would buy U.S. engineering firm LFE Industrial Systems Corp from Mark IV Industries Inc of the U.S. for $12.5 million in cash.
LFE, based in Clinton, Massachusetts, forecast it would make profits of $1.8 million for the year to February 1997 on turnover of $10 million. Its net assets were $1.2 million.

LFE designs, makes and sells thickness gauges for industrial process industries. It has a strong customer base in the United States, proven product technology and application knowledge in the rubber and coating industries, Eurotherm said.
LFE will become part of Eurotherm's gauging division and will expand the range of Eurotherm's products and market presence.
Eurotherm itself makes electronic equipment for use in industrial applications.
